newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca squeezed higher, Merrill positive.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca squeezed higher, Merrill positive.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Plc hit a record close on Friday, squeezed higher by a shortage of stock in the market and propelled by positive comment from analysts at Merrill Lynch, dealers and analysts said.
Zeneca shares closed 77p higher at 18.94-1/2 stg, surpassing the previous high of 18.17-1/2 set yesterday.

Merrill analyst Nigel Barnes said he had set a price target of 20.50 stg for Zeneca shares and $100 per ADR, reflecting expected strong growth in Zeneca products and prospects for gains in other U.S. drug stocks.
Barnes said U.S. investors had shown renewed interest in Zeneca shares since the company's chief executive David Barnes spoke at the brokerage's healthcare conference last week.
"New products are coming through and there is a high level of underlying growth," Barnes said.
Earlier dealers said renewed buying interest in the stock had met a shortage of stock in the market, squeezing the price higher and sparked a renewed bout of longstanding bid speculation.
